Her name serves as a reminder of God's power to grant salvation and deliverance. The name Jezabella carries the meaning “God will give” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
